name: capell-app/inertia-react-adapter
description: React 19 client for Capell pages with page and widget components, for sites whose front-end team writes React.

healthChecks.label: Capell Inertia React adapter is registered.

marketplace.summary: Switch Capell Inertia to React with one setting, and pages arrive as React 19 components with the build packages declared for you.
marketplace.description: React 19 components for Capell pages, built for teams who write their public site in React. Set the adapter to react and the page, content, image and title components replace the Vue ones. The npm packages your build needs are declared for you.
marketplace.problem: Our front-end team works in React, and nobody wants to build the components that show Capell pages.
marketplace.outcome: Your React team gets page and widget components once the adapter setting says react, and editors keep working in the admin.

faq.question: How do I switch my site over to React?
faq.answer: Vue is the default, and one setting changes it to react, which swaps in this adapter. Only one adapter runs on a site, so you pick one.

faq.question: What does it add to my front-end build?
faq.answer: React 19, Inertia's React library and Vite's React integration. Its script runs only when React is chosen, and only on pages shown through Inertia.

faq.question: Does it come with a look of its own?
faq.answer: No. The components add class names such as capell-inertia-page but no styles, so you set the look.

faq.question: What shows for a widget that has no React component of its own?
faq.answer: Content, image and title widgets each have a React component. Any other widget type uses the content component, which shows only a title and content.
